fusions.name: Slow Harvest
fusions.desc: Winds up for 1.5 seconds, then swings a full circle, dealing 34 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Lowered-Horn Hew
fusions.desc: Drives in with a lowered shoulder and hews for 13 damage, knocking the target back 3.5 tiles and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Furrow
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Labour
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
